lines.text: Okay. Stone didn't work. We need a real lock.
Hook latch. Let's see a bandit do THAT.

lines.why: whispered, eyes on the raccoon (we see her over his shoulder)

lines.text: That's a word for good with your hands. Five fingers... and they feel everything.

lines.why: called out to the raccoon, from far away

lines.text: She's not a bandit, chat. She's feeding her family.
If you see one: give it space, make a little noise, and never feed it.
If they can open anything... maybe the answer is UP.
